info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Operational Service By Param1-spec
info.description: The Operational Service Management API enables users to modify the details of operational services based on specific parameters. This endpoint allows for the patching of operational service data, facilitating updates to information such as processing orders identified by a unique parameter. It is designed for financial institutions and service managers who need to adapt service configurations rapidly in response to business conditions. Use cases include adjusting service parameters and updating operational details to improve efficiency.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific processing order identified by the resource ID. Ensure to provide the necessary data in the request body to reflect the changes you want to apply to the order.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the operational processing order identified by 'RES-100045'. Please provide all necessary fields as specified in the schema to ensure the operation is processed correctly.

200.description: Request processed successfully with updated order details.
